localizedValues.name: Heritage Hall
localizedValues.description:
• Hours of operation: 9:00AM to 8:00PM • The hall capacity is 150 seats. • 40 tables (approximately 3’x4’). • 150 chairs. • No in-park catering or set-up services available. • An interior kitchen with one house sized fridge and stove, two microwaves, four deep wash sinks and approximately 40’ of various counter spaces. • No coffee maker, cutlery, cups, plates or pots or pans are available. • Kitchen has hot and cold running water. • One log fire place in main hall area. • Main hall room is only heated by fire place. Kitchen has ceiling heaters (Building can be cool in the early spring or early fall). • No interior washrooms (a public washroom building is approximately 15 meters away). • Pathway access to hall from the Parks parking lot (approximately 140 stalls) Arrangements to be made with Park Operator for limited drop-off vehicle access. • Limited power receptacles in main hall room. • The facility has no overhead projection screen or sound system. • No curtains or blinds on windows. • Outside of Hall is a public space and cannot be reserved for exclusive sole use. • Outside of Hall has two (2) large barbeque pits. • Hall is within minutes of park gardens, the historic Peace Arch and the International boundary between Canada and the USA.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
